# Replicate

Replicate allows users to run AI models via a cloud API without managing infrastructure.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/replicate/.

## Actions

- **Get File Details** (read-only): Get details of a file by its id.
- **Get Model Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific model by owner and name.
- **Get Model README** (read-only): Get the readme content for a model in markdown format.
- **List Files** (read-only): List all files created by the user or organization.
- **Create file**: Create a file by uploading content.
- **Create Prediction**: Create a prediction for a given deployment.
- **List model collections** (read-only): List all collections of models.
- **List model examples** (read-only): List example predictions for a specific model.
